args.query: bridge condition poor percent state NBI

sql: SELECT "year", COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition='Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poor, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition='Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS pct_poor, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition='Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0 AS p FROM transport.bridges WHERE record_type='1' AND state_code='36' AND "year" IN (2021,2022,2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT "year", COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition='Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS pct_poor FROM transport.bridges WHERE record_type='1' AND "year" IN (2022,2024,2025) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT "year", bridge_condition, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transport.bridges WHERE record_type='1' AND state_code='36' AND "year" IN (2022,2025) GROUP BY "year", bridge_condition ORDER BY "year", bridge_condition
SELECT "year", bridge_condition, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transport.bridges WHERE record_type='1' AND "year" IN (2022,2025) GROUP BY "year", bridge_condition ORDER BY "year", bridge_condition
